subject: maths
question: A man has to cover a distance of 387 km in 18 hours. If he covers two-third of this distance in 6/9 of the time, then what should his speed (in km/hr) be to cover the remaining distance in the time left?
solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 387 km

Total time = 18 hours

He covers 2/3 of distance in 6/9 of time

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

Distance covered = (2/3) × 387 = 258 km

Time taken = (6/9) × 18 = 12 hours

Remaining distance = 387 - 258 = 129 km

Remaining time = 18 - 12 = 6 hours

Required speed = Remaining distance ÷ Remaining time

⇒ 129 ÷ 6 = 21.5 km/hr

**∴ Required speed = 21.5 km/hr**
